name: Your First Deterministic Cross
description:
With both carrot and potato seeds in hand, you are now ready to deterministically breed your first new species. Sugarcane.

Plant your potato and carrot seeds next to a double crop stick placed on one of the fitting soil types shown in NEI.

[warn]Always check NEI for what soil to use when breeding a new crop.[/warn]

When breeding, it's important to ensure that the crop stick that will contain the new crop meets all the growth requirements of said new crop. [warn]Crops with special growth requirements will not appear unless all their growth requirements are met.[/warn] This includes things like soil, sub-soil, and light level.
